## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they pass locally (backend `npx jest`, frontend `npm test`)
- [ ] Lint, type-check and build pass
- [ ] No secret, key or `.env` file in the change (CI runs a secret scan too)
- [ ] A database change has a migration, a rollback file in `backend/prisma/rollbacks`, and a `-- destructive:` note if it removes data
- [ ] New environment variables are in the right `.env.example`, with a comment
- [ ] Behaviour changes for store owners or shoppers are described above
